labs.title: Foundations, files, Chat, and the first saved website

checks.fresh-install: Fresh-cache locked core installation succeeds; on-create Copilot CLI and the Website preview helper verified separately; no Chromium or research dependency startup requirement
checks.access: GitHub and editor Chat work with the intended attendee account
checks.orientation: Concepts-only GitHub tour from the Day 1 guide that attendees watch; at 09:30 an attendee-like account made a private copy of the template in agentic-dev-labs with Use this template, and the guide was opened with Open Preview in browser-based Codespaces before terminal use
checks.chat-turn: A real editor Chat request and refinement completed without terminal setup
checks.first-website: 10:00 block from the Day 1 guide: actual /create-website invocation asked only which website (six starters or My own idea) and built the tested blueprint named after the repository, with no notes file; every file staged, committed, pushed, and site/index.html read back on the same branch on GitHub

labs.title: A second website and manual verification

checks.own-idea: After the first page was pushed, /create-website built a second website (another starter by description, or an own idea) from one sentence in site/ideas/<name>/ straight away, without asking for checks first; the first page was unchanged and /start-website still opened it
checks.preview: Actual Website preview panel renders beside Chat, updates by itself on changes with added entries kept, and stop/start reopens the same saved page without file changes; blockers recorded truthfully
checks.manual-behaviour: Coached 11:45 block: expected-versus-observed manual button check, with real fixes rechecked
checks.source-check: Coached 11:45 block: the starter's count, or Weather against its raw forecast data, checked by the learner, not the model's confidence

optional_checks.read-code: Optional: Chat explained selected lines of site/index.html, and the learner changed the <h1> headline by hand; the preview updated after saving and a broken edit was recoverable with Ctrl+Z
optional_checks.research-mcp: Selected optional browser and document tools actually invoked; installation alone is insufficient
optional_checks.browser-download: Playwright inspected the official archive and at least one actual PDF download and reporting year; remaining years and blockers recorded truthfully
optional_checks.conversion: A real MarkItDown conversion inspected; complete file output retained and any CLI fallback or truncation distinguished from MCP success
optional_checks.facts: Comparable facts checked against original public sources with years, units, locations, calculations, and live/prepared labels
optional_checks.visual-brief: Optional visual-brief invoked with verified facts without overwriting the learner's site; charts, references, navigation, and layout checked

checks.implementation: A chart from /add-chart (or /add-chat, or a workshop picture) added to an existing page, drawn from its own fictional entries, with safe text handling
checks.personalisation: Chosen Project Planner, Calendar, Ideas Wall, Weather, Princeton Map, Photo Studio, or own-idea page gets the chosen chart or chat and one visual improvement through ordinary Chat, without repeating creation or switching frameworks; actual diff and page inspected
checks.manual-checks: The chart followed a manual add/tick or equivalent journey and matched the learner's own count, or a chat answer was compared with the page; keyboard access and narrow layout checked honestly
checks.preview: Learner reopened the private preview and recorded actual results and remaining limitations
checks.undo: A deliberately bold Copilot change was reverted with Chat's Undo and the page returned to its previous state

optional_checks.storage: If selected, add/reload/present/remove/reload observed in one browser; corrupt or unavailable storage handled without clearing other apps' data
optional_checks.sketch: Optional: docs/images/sketch-example.png attached to Chat and the page restyled toward it with entries and features kept; a model without image input recorded as blocked, not passed
optional_checks.ai-picture: Optional: a picture drawn by the workshop helper was placed in the page from a plain Chat request; a Codespace without the secrets recorded as blocked, not passed

checks.reviewed-files: Selected changes and site assets exclude private material, credentials, full reports, and unrelated changes
checks.reviewed-commit: Reviewed work pushed and read back on the intended GitHub branch through the beginner workflow
checks.checked-feature: Private preview still works after the last improvement; learner explains an actual check and limitation
checks.no-azure-login: No attendee Azure login or credential creation used; publication is not required for Monday
checks.github-tour: Commit message generated with the sparkle icon and corrected, pushed, and the commit list, one commit's changes, and the History of site/index.html found on GitHub

optional_checks.actions: Deploy workflow succeeded for that commit using the prepared runner identity
optional_checks.endpoint: Website-target artifact and fresh responses match the exact commit, label, entry-page bytes, and site fingerprint; no vendor-app substitution
optional_checks.deployed-behaviour: Chosen interaction verified at the actual new deployment URL, not just the health endpoint
optional_checks.deployed-storage: Only if storage was selected, its journey repeated at the deployment origin without assuming preview state transfers
optional_checks.challenge: A bronze, silver, or gold challenge-card level completed and checked by the learner
optional_checks.bonus: Optional bonus: the afternoon feature not picked first (a chart, /add-chat, or a picture) added and checked against the page

checks.idea-brief: Participant chose an own idea or the default, described one user outcome and check, and used the /create-website own-idea route in site/ideas/ without overwriting Monday's work
checks.prototype: A bounded prototype or improved default works with fictional app-local content; no service integration or account migration was required
checks.manual-journey: Expected versus observed user journey, input handling, and one useful improvement checked manually
checks.saved-work: Reviewed changes committed, pushed, and read back from the intended GitHub branch
checks.handover: Working features and unresolved data/access/approval questions recorded for the technical owner; no training membership or personal account deleted

labs.title: VS Code and a User Requirements agent

checks.tickets: Two or three tickets written with the Requirement issue template from the Next wishes in site/README.md, and a Board project named after the learner that imports the repository and shows in its Projects tab; new tickets appeared on the board by themselves
checks.cli-turn: Actual Codespaces Copilot CLI sign-in with /login and the device code, and a question about the learner's own page compared with the page
checks.github-tool: A GitHub tool through MCP listed the open tickets in Copilot CLI after the learner allowed it by name, and the list matched the board
checks.skill: Learner-described .github/skills/user-stories/SKILL.md with the ticket's user story and acceptance criteria format, written by Copilot CLI and edited by the learner
checks.requirements-agent: Learner-described .github/agents/user-requirements.agent.md that reads a ticket with the GitHub tools, uses the user-stories skill, and updates the ticket with gh only after the learner agrees; written by Copilot CLI, edited by the learner, and listed by /agent after a CLI restart
checks.criteria: Every ticket holds a user story and Given/When/Then criteria from the agent, through gh issue edit or pasted by hand (recorded truthfully); each criterion validated as checkable; approved tickets moved to Todo
checks.ticket-built: The approved ticket moved to In Progress and implemented on the learner's page; every criterion checked by hand in the Website preview, with one debug round recorded truthfully
checks.tests: Learner tests in checks/test_*.py written with checks/website.py; pytest checks shown green, red after a deliberate break, and green again; the requirements list and build and run commands written in site/README.md
checks.checkpoint: Skill, agent, page, tests and site/README.md reviewed, committed with Closes #N, and pushed; the ticket closed itself and the board moved it to Done

optional_checks.vscode-agent: The same agent file chosen in VS Code Chat's agent picker and its answer compared with Copilot CLI
optional_checks.github-mcp: Optional: the read-only GitHub MCP server in .vscode/mcp.json started in VS Code Chat, no write tools, recent commits matched GitHub
optional_checks.teach-copilot: Optional Day 3 extra: /add-chat added to the page and one answer checked against the page, with the FOUNDRY_* workshop identity
optional_checks.browser-demo: Optional presenter browser-tools demonstration rehearsed in the presenter's Codespace

labs.title: Feature branches, a versioned pipeline, cloud agents and a Code Review agent

checks.ruleset: A Protect main ruleset on the default branch requiring pull requests with 0 approvals and an empty bypass list, with Copilot code review left off; a direct push to main refused
checks.version: The version line switched on in publish-website.yml on a feature branch, the footer showing Preview in the preview, and after the merge the live website showing Version 1.0.<run number> from version.json
checks.branch-pr: Feature branches created in the Codespace, published, opened as pull requests, their Files changed read by the learner, merged, deleted, and pulled back into main
checks.review-agent: Learner-described .github/instructions/review.instructions.md and .github/agents/code-review.agent.md with the findings-table report format, merged through a pull request, and the agent listed by /agent
checks.report: reviews/pr-N.md written by the review agent for Copilot's pull request; every finding marked Confirmed or Not a problem by the learner with a reason, and anything the agent missed noted
checks.iteration: An @copilot comment on a confirmed finding produced a new commit on the pull request; the criterion, pytest checks, and a second report were rerun; a neighbour checked one criterion
checks.decision: The pull request merged and deployed with the next version number (or closed with a reason), main pulled, and the report merged through a pull request

optional_checks.publication: A website without an address got one with /publish-website before the ruleset, verified at the actual URL for the exact commit
optional_checks.criteria-automation: Presenter demo and optional extra: an automation on new Requirement tickets added a user story and criteria with the user-stories skill, then was disabled
optional_checks.joining-today: A newcomer followed the catch-up at the top of the Day 4 guide: one Requirement ticket with a story and criteria drafted by Chat, ready for the delegation lab

labs.title: Delegate an approved ticket to the cloud agent

checks.issue-session: An approved ticket from the board, with its user story and acceptance criteria, assigned to the actual cloud agent and moved to In Progress, with its session inspected
checks.review: The draft pull request linked to the ticket; its diff compared with the ticket by the learner; scope limited to the requested files
checks.merged-check: Merged change deployed by the pipeline with the next version number and checked on the live website; the ticket closed and moved to Done

optional_checks.website-change: The simpler Website change for Copilot template used for a change that is not a ticket from the board

checks.workflow: Starter copied to .github/workflows/check-my-website.yml on a branch, pull_request and push triggers added, contents permission reduced to read, both jobs green on its own pull request, and merged
checks.required-checks: Check the website and UI check added as required status checks in the Protect main ruleset, blocking a merge while red
checks.ci: A pull request whose UI check went red from a deliberate 900-pixel banner, its log table and home-phone.png read (and the log explained by Copilot CLI), fixed to green, and merged
checks.ui-check: Desktop and phone screenshots opened from the run's Artifacts and the summary table read for the first page and any idea pages
checks.cd: Both slot starters merged with the version line kept, the learner a required reviewer of the production environment, Copilot's pull request run after Approve workflows to run, its Deploy feature slot run started with Approve and run, View deployment showing the strip with pull request, version, and build, the criteria checked there, an approved review and merge, and a production release published only after Review deployments > Approve and deploy, with the same content number as the feature slot
checks.recovery: scripts/smoke_test.py passed, failed on a deliberately bad sentence that the checks could not see, and passed again after a Revert pull request, with the content fingerprint back to the known-good value and a higher version
checks.demos: Team demo of the board and one ticket's criteria, a verified review finding, and CI/CD evidence with a screenshot rehearsed in the actual room setup
checks.handoff: HANDOFF.md naming the agents, skill, board, review rules, ruleset, pipeline steps, release and rollback, release owner, and routes to make it real (including Novo's own GitHub Enterprise and its validation process for GxP use) merged through a pull request

optional_checks.smoke-in-pipeline: Optional smoke-test step added to the publishing workflow
optional_checks.agentic-workflow: Optional presenter demo of a GitHub Agentic Workflow (public preview) billed to the organization through GITHUB_TOKEN
optional_checks.joining-today: A newcomer followed the catch-up at the top of the Day 5 guide: an address with /publish-website and the Protect main ruleset before the workflow lab
